{{Top|leg}}
'''Laser lathes''' were high-precision, high energy lasers used to repair equipment. The part to be repaired was carefully placed on a grid encased in laser-resistant cowling. Then the operator sat at the chair and scanned the part via [[Holocamera/Legends|holocam]], and would input the precise angle, length and strength of burn in the control pad.

The maintenance section of the ''[[Black Ice/Legends|Black Ice]]'' had one of these devices.
